notes: Jam rebuilt from the ground up as an auto-band: pick a genre (Rock, Pop, Blues Shuffle, Funk, Ballad, Latin) and it writes a song — intro, verse, chorus, ending — that follows YOUR key from the context bar and re-harmonizes live when you change it. Shape the song with section editing (repeats, bars per chord, add/remove chords from the diatonic palette), an energy dial, a swing slider, and a per-instrument mixer. Tap a palette chord (or play one on MIDI) while the band plays to vamp on it, hit Finish for a real ending. Your old progressions migrate automatically.
